question.text: Per Section 3.1 of Chapter 3 (data as on February 2025), how many NPOs were onboarded on NSE SSE and BSE SSE respectively at that date?

answer.text: 60 on NSE SSE and 30 on BSE SSE
100 on NSE SSE and 100 on BSE SSE
115 on NSE SSE and 51 on BSE SSE
200 on NSE SSE and 200 on BSE SSE

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Section 3.1 (opening paragraph): 'As on February 2025, 115 Non-Governmental Organisations have on-boarded the NSE SSE and 51 NPOs have onboarded the BSE SSE.' These are the chapter-specified counts. SIAs should track updated figures but the exam tests the chapter reference. **The Trap:** Other options are plausible round-number distractors. Candidates must anchor on the specific February 2025 snapshot in the textbook. **Cross-Exam Context:** No direct cross-exam — this is an SSE-specific fact. XII / III-A / XV do not test it. **Assessor's Pro-Tip:** Quote the February 2025 baseline but ALWAYS look up current figures on nseindia.com SSE portal and bsesocialstockexchange.com at engagement start. SSE onboarding has grown rapidly and current numbers will diverge. For board-level SIA presentations, use a two-column 'then vs now' view.
